collection.description: A scout is overdue, and villagers fear a kidnapping although no evidence yet supports it.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: (scout), a scout, is overdue, and villagers fear a kidnapping although no evidence yet supports it.

a1.name: Outcome A1
a1.text: Footprints lead to a sheltered ravine.

a2.name: Outcome A2
a2.text: Scouts find a damaged marker and widen the search.

b1.name: Outcome B1
b1.text: The {@chief} refuses to accuse a neighboring tribe without evidence.

b2.name: Outcome B2
b2.text: (villager), an anxious villager, is heard but reminded that suspicion is not proof.

c1.name: Outcome C1
c1.text: Small teams travel with clear check-in plans.

c2.name: Outcome C2
c2.text: (healer), a healer, waits ready without assuming the worst.

d1.name: Outcome D1
d1.text: (scout) returns after sheltering from a rockfall.

d2.name: Outcome D2
d2.text: (scout) returns shaken and is given time before recounting events.
